name: Estinien Varlineau
oracle_text:
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put a +1/+1 counter on Estinien Varlineau. It gains flying until end of turn.
At the beginning of your second main phase, you draw X cards and lose X life, where X is the number of your opponents who were dealt combat damage by Estinien Varlineau or a Dragon this turn.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of your second main phase, you draw X cards and lose X life, where X is the number of your opponents who were dealt combat damage by Estinien Varlineau or a Dragon this turn.

needs.what: a player spec (or value) naming the opponents dealt combat damage this turn by this creature OR by any source with a given subtype (Dragon), so X can be counted as the number of distinct such opponents -- e.g. {"dealt_combat_damage_by": {"any_of": ["self", {"subtypes": ["Dragon"]}]}} countable as a number of players
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `dealt_combat_damage_by` player spec takes only "self" and stands alone (the loader refuses any other subject), so it cannot include Dragons; the `combat_damage_by` condition (prowl) is a yes/no over subtypes and neither counts players nor includes the source itself; no value key counts the players a player spec resolves to
